page_title: LYO 4-0 REI | Lyon v Reims 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' 4 - 0 It's a goal! Rayan Cherki plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Georges Mikautadze (Lyon). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 4:0.
90+3' Francois Letexier blows his whistle and it's Malick Fofana (Lyon) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+2' Lyon enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' It is time for a substitution. Ikechukwu Orazi (Reims) is on for Mamadou Diakhon.
88' Samba Diawara decides to make a substitution. Junya Ito will be replaced by Sekine Hiroki (Reims).
87' Zabi (Reims) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
83' Thiago Almada (Lyon) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
81' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Tanner Tessmann is replaced by Jordan Veretout (Lyon).
81' That will be all from Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Abner Vinicius.
81' Cedric Kipre (Reims) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post.
79' 3 - 0 Goal! Malick Fofana plays a pass to the feet of Rayan Cherki (Lyon), and he shoots into the top right corner from inside the box. It's 3:0.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Niama Sissoko (Reims) comes onto the pitch for Oumar Diakite.
75' Substitution. Zabi receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sergio Akieme (Reims) walks off.
74' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) replaces Sael Kumbedi.
74' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Malick Fofana (Lyon) replacing Ernest Nuamah.
74' Here is a change. Nemanja Matic (Lyon) is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Thiago Almada.
73' Junya Ito (Reims) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

73' Buta (Reims) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Reims.

68' 2 - 0 Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) outjumps the defence in the centre of the box and connects with the free kick from Rayan Cherki. He sends the ball inside the right post with his towering header and alters the score to 2:0.
67' It seemed like Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
67' Nhoa Sangui (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.
66' Samba Diawara has decided to substitute John Joe Patrick Finn and he is replaced by Amadou Kone (Reims).
65' Junya Ito (Reims) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lucas Perri, who smothers the ball.
64' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
63' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
61' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lucas Perri reads it well and gathers the ball.
60' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
60' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
58' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
58' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) takes the corner kick, but Yehvann Diouf reads it well and stops the effort.

58' That was a nice football moment. Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Yehvann Diouf guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! Lyon will take a corner kick.
56' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
55' What a great touch by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
55' The ball is cleared after Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
53' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
53' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Yehvann Diouf is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
52' Junya Ito (Reims) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francois Letexier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
50' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
48' Junya Ito (Reims) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
48' Reims force a corner. They send men into the box.
47' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away. Reims win a corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Yehvann Diouf makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
45+2' A nice individual effort by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Reims, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Francois Letexier stops the game and makes a call.
43' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the corner but it's cleared.
43' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Lyon can continue in their attacking effort.
42' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
41' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
40' Lyon failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Lyon have a corner.

40' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lyon.
36' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Corentin Tolisso plays it into the box, and Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:0.
31' Clinton Mata (Lyon) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
28' Junya Ito (Reims) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
28' Junya Ito (Reims) works the corner short.
27' Nhoa Sangui (Reims) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Good work from Reims as they win a corner.
27' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
24' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
23' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
21' Buta (Reims) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

20' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but is easily stopped by a save from Yehvann Diouf and the score remains the same.
19' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
15' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
11' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Oumar Diakite (Reims) for his blatant foul.
11' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
11' Francois Letexier blows for a foul after Clinton Mata (Lyon) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Reims in a dangerous position.
10' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
8' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
7' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

6' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Yehvann Diouf.
5' Georges Mikautadze receives a short pass from Ernest Nuamah (Lyon), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort.
2' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
2' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Now Lyon have a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Lyon will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Francois Letexier.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
